key_facts: On November 1, 2024 at approximately 12:54 a.m., CHP Officers Santiago Meza-Gonzalez (#023295) and Jose Melano (#023054) contacted Plaintiff on the eastbound I-580 dirt shoulder near Isabel Avenue, Livermore (CHP Case No. RJ68845; CAD No. 241101GG0064). The 62-minute dashcam recording (00:54:36–01:57:10) and the contemporaneous DS-367 Officer's Statement (captioned to 'ngwanforbi' / License F7953179) are the core proof that the arrest report's alcohol-odor, slurred-speech, and beverage-present observations are fabricated. Dublin CHP later issued a Penal Code § 849(b)(1) / § 851.6 Detention Certificate reclassifying the event as a detention only. This matter consolidates those incident PDFs — Arrest Report, DS-367, dashcam transcript (Exhibit A), DMV DAD / DS-2044 discovery packet, and CHP Discovery Response — under the Ngwa Nforbi v. Meza-Gonzalez caption. They previously lived in documents/_shared/chp-nov1-2024/ and were cross-listed on Matters 1, 2, and 7.
procedural_status: Opened August 7, 2026 as Matter 32 to give the November 1, 2024 CHP incident evidence set a dedicated matter home under the Ngwa Nforbi name form used on the DS-367. No complaint, summons, or fee waiver has been filed under this caption. The parallel state tort action already on file is Matter 2 (Newanforbi v. Meza-Gonzalez et al., Alameda Superior Court No. 26CV168913), which remains stayed pending final resolution of federal Matter 1. Matters 1, 2, and 7 continue to list these PDFs by path as cross-referenced evidence; Matter 32 is the owning folder. Any future filing under this caption would need an independent case number and would have to be coordinated with Matter 2 to avoid duplicative damages and inconsistent pleadings.
damages: None separately demanded under this caption. Operative damages for the November 1, 2024 encounter remain those pleaded in Matter 1 (federal §1983) and Matter 2 (state false imprisonment / battery / Bane Act). This matter's role is documentary — it owns the incident PDFs so the portfolio has a single canonical path for the Ngwa Nforbi–captioned evidence set rather than a _shared/ folder.
risk: Low as an evidence-home entry. The principal risk is caption confusion with Matter 2 (Newanforbi v. Meza-Gonzalez): the same officers and the same incident, different name-form on the caption. Do not plead or demand overlapping damages under Matter 32 without expressly reserving or dismissing the Matter 2 claim set. Path churn for Matters 1/2/7 is already resolved by pointing their documents[] entries at /documents/matter-32/.
